items.title: Bangladesh faces higher cost for debut dollar bond
items.description: Bangladesh could sell its first sovereign bond to foreign investors in December, but it would probably have to pay interest of about 8.5 percent a year, higher than the 7-8 percent the government had planned for.

items.title: Vietnam remains ASEAN’s most optimistic market in 2026: study
items.description: Vietnam remained ASEAN’s most optimistic market in 2026 with a consumer sentiment score of 63 despite a four-point decline from last year, according to the annual UOB ASEAN Consumer Sentiment Study.

items.title: Bitcoin falls to its lowest in two years
items.description: Bitcoin, the ​world’s largest cryptocurrency by market value, ‌slid to its lowest level in two years on Friday as worries over ​stretched valuations in artificial intelligence stocks ​rattled investors and weighed on other risk assets.
